answers.core: It streamlines the workflow for animation through QOL fixes. I'd argue this addresses what is often a core flaw in any animation software. They're usually full of very powerful features, but using them can be an absolute slog. I wouldn't be surprised if people will save hours of work with a highlighting system since you're not always scrolling around the place looking at track labels.
answers.workaround: I doubt it would be very invasive and I can't imagine anyone not finding it useful when you're scrolling through all this similar looking info. But I think adding a toggle setting for it would be easy enough.

title: Highlight the relevant track(s) when selecting something to animate
